paper_title: Precision Metrology Meets Cosmology: Improved Constraints on Ultralight Dark Matter from Atom-Cavity Frequency Comparisons
coupling_convention: d_e, dimensionless electromagnetic gauge modulus, as plotted
notes: Paper constrains dilatonic dark matter couplings d_e (electromagnetic gauge modulus / fine-structure constant variation = ScalarPhoton) and d_me (electron mass = ScalarElectron). Main plot Fig 2a is d_e vs mass (1e-16 to 1e-21 eV). Assumes 0.3 GeV/cm^3 local DM density (Eq. 6). 95% CL. Data points are approximate reads from the exclusion curves and dynamical decoupling extension (Fig 3, up to ~1e-14 eV); precise tabulated values not available in text. Note the paper also sets d_me limits (~4e-5 at lowest masses) which correspond to ScalarElectron; if that coupling were the target the values would differ.
